name: Computer Science
description: Artificial intelligence, full-stack web development, and cybersecurity, taught through project-based studios rather than lecture halls alone.

name: Business Administration
description: Leadership, global marketing, and finance fundamentals, with a semester-long consultancy project for a real client organization.

name: Mechanical Engineering
description: Robotics, thermodynamics, and manufacturing design, anchored by a fully equipped machine shop and robotics lab.

name: Design
description: UI/UX and graphic design practice, from typography fundamentals to shipped portfolio work with industry critique panels.

name: Data Science
description: Statistics, machine learning, and data visualization, built around real datasets from partner labs rather than textbook exercises.

name: Architecture
description: Structural design, sustainable materials, and studio critique, culminating in a thesis building presented to a licensed-architect review panel.

name: Law
description: Constitutional law, legal writing, and ethics, with moot court competition every term and a supervised legal-clinic placement in the final year.

name: Psychology
description: Cognition, research methods, and clinical foundations, with lab placements in the on-campus behavioral research unit from second year onward.
